gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.218: A hunter's draught works for minutes and leaves toxin behind. Drink two strong ones close together and you will feel the load.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.219: A brew drunk leaves a spent phial in your pack. Strong spirit refills it at an alchemy bench, while you sleep, or sitting by a campfire.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.220: A hunter's brew needs its formula before the crucible will make it. Formulas turn up in old chests and with the wandering trader.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.221: A skinning knife carves an organ from a grown monster's body. A monster brew made from it works ten minutes and leaves a heavy load.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.222: A hunter's flask holds four doses of one drink and makes each work twice as long. Sneak with a bottle in your other hand to pour it in.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.223: A testing needle, a poison in your other hand and a strong creature near death will tell you which way the poison leans.
